name: DekoVägi slide style
source: Measured with extract_all.py from 17 decks (205 slides, 3021 text runs, 447 pictures). The canonical value is the one most decks use; near-duplicates are unified (see audit).
units: pt. The slide is 1215 x 810 pt (16.875 x 11.25 in, 3:2). For HTML at 1620 x 1080 px multiply by 4/3.

grid.notes: Text never starts left of x 78 or ends right of x 1137, except text inside a colour panel or card, which keeps 48 pt padding. Photos may bleed to any slide edge. Nothing but the logo sits below y 724.

cream.use: default page background; text on dark backgrounds

paper.use: tinted panel on cream, empty image placeholder

olive.use: dark background: concept, statement, numbers, closing

wine.use: dark background, second choice (the burgundy background)

body.use: body text, bullets and small labels on light backgrounds

accent.use: italic title accent, kicker label and meta values on light backgrounds. Text only, never a background.

rose.use: italic accent, kicker label and small labels on dark backgrounds

gold.use: kicker mark, photo numbers, short accent rules, outlines

night.use: photo scrim only (with transparency), never a page background

not_allowed: neon or client colours as backgrounds

fonts.only: these two families; no third font (JetBrains Mono dropped 07.11.2026)
fonts.numerals: lining (font-variant-numeric: lining-nums); Cormorant's default old-style figures read as letters

display.use: cover title, 1 or 2 lines; line 2 italic accent

opener.use: section opener title, line 2 italic accent

statement.use: one big sentence on colour, last words italic accent

h1.use: slide title; second line or last words italic accent

h2.use: long heading (3 lines), closing line, caption title over a photo, title in a narrow band or card

h3.use: name under a large image (table, zone, option)

name.use: photo caption, item name in a grid, meta value (italic, accent), contact value

kicker.use: label above every title, accent colour

mark.use: kept for reference only: the kicker mark is now the logo leaf (see kicker_block.mark)

body.use: paragraphs and bullets, max about 60 characters per line

small.use: item details, captions under photos, text in the bottom band of the photo-on-top layout

label.use: meta labels (KLIENT, KUUPÄEV), table headers, small tags

number.use: photo and item numbers 01, 02, 03 at the right end of a caption line

figure.use: key numbers on the numbers slide

watermark.use: not used: no text behind an image (Meelis, 06.11.2026). Kept only so old decks can be checked.

mark.source: the leaf above the Ä in the DekoVägi logo, filled gold #A98A5E

kicker_block.notes: the gold logo leaf (16.5 pt tall, centred on the label and raised 2.25 pt) and the label sit on one line at x 78 on every slide that has a kicker, cover included; the title starts 22 pt below the kicker line.

bullets.char: small round dot in the accent colour (rose on dark)

standard_right.use: only when the bottom-left corner holds text or a photo (photo-on-top layout, full-bleed photo with caption bottom left)

cover_card.use: cover D44 only: centred at the top of the title card, no kicker (Meelis, 06.11.2026)

logo.notes: One logo per slide. Never inside a photo collage cell; centred only in the D44 title card.

hairline.use: full content width (1059) under the cover title and above the meta row; between rows of lists and tables

rules: Every image slot uses one of the listed ratios; the gallery states the ratio per slot. Collage cells are free (they fill a grid).
A rendered final (photo, render, collage cell) fills its slot edge to edge (cover crop); a cut-out object sits on the background inside its box (contain).
Photos bleed to the slide edge or sit on the grid; never floating at random positions.

No rounded corners, borders or drop shadows on photos, except where a layout defines it: circle (D22, D43), arch (D40), and a 9 pt background-colour edge on a photo that overlaps another (D48, D62, D20). Cut-outs: no drop shadow.
Collage gaps: 6 pt in the background colour.
Minimum source size: 1.5 x the slot in pt (a full-bleed photo needs at least 1800 x 1200 px).

copy.titles: sentence case, the italic accent is the last word or the second line
copy.kicker: one or two words, uppercase by style (type them normally)

decided: Kicker mark: the gold logo leaf, raised a few px above centre, on every kicker (Meelis, 06.11.2026; options on marks.html).
Short side facts (room, guests, time): a ruled label/value list (label left, italic accent value right, hairlines between), never a lone floating sentence (Meelis, 07.11.2026; D5).
Deck order: every client deck ends with D9 Lähenemine (standard text) then D31 contact; the order list D27 is internal only (Meelis, 07.11.2026).
Key numbers (D26) in the accent colour; section opener D82 (arch photo + cut-out) by default, D8 only without a photo (Meelis, 06-07.11.2026).

Deck roles (Meelis, 09.11.2026): cover first (pick one of D1, D40-D44), D9 second to last, D31 last; edge cases D8, D49, D54, D38, D32 only when their condition applies; D27 internal only. Details: gallery deck-rules.md.
Two font families only: Cormorant Garamond and Hanken Grotesk. The small gold item numbers (01, 02, 03 on D21, D38, D39) are Hanken Grotesk Bold, not JetBrains Mono (Meelis, 07.11.2026).
open_decisions: Accent per project: #8E2B39 burgundy (default) or #A24E2C terracotta (template K08)?
Page numbers ('02/ 10', bottom right) appear only in the base deck: dropped by default; if used, Hanken Grotesk like the item numbers.
